q2_gaps: Whether a counted plural filling a NON-subject role (here the Theme of a passive) also takes the per-member distribution rule. The distributive-predicate trigger and every example given for it ('the dogs barked', 'both dogs barked', 'all the students passed') put the group in subject/undergoer position, so a counted group in Theme position is left undetermined - group-only, or group plus a rule over (PartOf $x sk_group_1) carrying the Theme role.
notes: The by-phrase correctly takes the role the active subject would have had - Agent for a transitive, undemoted by the depot's inanimacy - and 'buy' correctly takes Theme for its unchanged object; group plus Cardinality 2 and Past are as specified.
